key_points: Ongoing share buyback program: ~13M shares repurchased for ~$228M since Oct 28, signaling capital return commitment
Project Jupiter loan exposure reduced via discounted sale after force majeure and regulatory issues - contained credit event
Widespread cybersecurity attack affecting 178 sites including HSBC - sector-wide issue, not HSBC-specific
Research actions (EssilorLuxottica downgrade, Nvidia Hold) and technical commentary are noise for HSBC equity
Blockchain cross-border payments trial with HKMA/Swift is early-stage positive but not near-term material
